name: Nemotron-Terminal-32B
notes: Terminal agent fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-32B. Base Qwen/Qwen3-32B scores 5.90 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (Terminus 2) vs 27.4 tuned: +21.5 pts on the same scaffold. KV basis: 64 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 262,144 B/token (256.0 KiB). config layer_types is 64/64 full_attention - the Qwen3-32B backbone with no sliding window - and head_dim 128 is explicit. max_position_embeddings 40960, so the cache is the whole 40K window at full depth. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card table matches claimed 27.4 for Nemotron-Terminal-32B on Terminal-Bench 2.0.
